import string

def _t():
    assert string.whitespace == ' \t\n\r\x0b\x0c', ('assertEqual', string.whitespace, ' \t\n\r\x0b\x0c')
    assert string.ascii_lowercase == 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', ('assertEqual', string.ascii_lowercase, 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
    assert string.ascii_uppercase == 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', ('assertEqual', string.ascii_uppercase, 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')
    assert string.ascii_letters == string.ascii_lowercase + string.ascii_uppercase, ('assertEqual', string.ascii_letters, string.ascii_lowercase + string.ascii_uppercase)
    assert string.digits == '0123456789', ('assertEqual', string.digits, '0123456789')
    assert string.hexdigits == string.digits + 'abcdefABCDEF', ('assertEqual', string.hexdigits, string.digits + 'abcdefABCDEF')
    assert string.octdigits == '01234567', ('assertEqual', string.octdigits, '01234567')
    assert string.punctuation == '!"#$%&\'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~', ('assertEqual', string.punctuation, '!"#$%&\'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~')
    assert string.printable == string.digits + string.ascii_lowercase + string.ascii_uppercase + string.punctuation + string.whitespace, ('assertEqual', string.printable, string.digits + string.ascii_lowercase + string.ascii_uppercase + string.punctuation + string.whitespace)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import string

def _t():
    assert string.capwords('abc def ghi') == 'Abc Def Ghi', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('abc def ghi'), 'Abc Def Ghi')
    assert string.capwords('abc\tdef\nghi') == 'Abc Def Ghi', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('abc\tdef\nghi'), 'Abc Def Ghi')
    assert string.capwords('abc\t   def  \nghi') == 'Abc Def Ghi', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('abc\t   def  \nghi'), 'Abc Def Ghi')
    assert string.capwords('ABC DEF GHI') == 'Abc Def Ghi', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('ABC DEF GHI'), 'Abc Def Ghi')
    assert string.capwords('ABC-DEF-GHI', '-') == 'Abc-Def-Ghi', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('ABC-DEF-GHI', '-'), 'Abc-Def-Ghi')
    assert string.capwords('ABC-def DEF-ghi GHI') == 'Abc-def Def-ghi Ghi', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('ABC-def DEF-ghi GHI'), 'Abc-def Def-ghi Ghi')
    assert string.capwords('   aBc  DeF   ') == 'Abc Def', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('   aBc  DeF   '), 'Abc Def')
    assert string.capwords('\taBc\tDeF\t') == 'Abc Def', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('\taBc\tDeF\t'), 'Abc Def')
    assert string.capwords('\taBc\tDeF\t', '\t') == '\tAbc\tDef\t', ('assertEqual', string.capwords('\taBc\tDeF\t', '\t'), '\tAbc\tDef\t')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
